status: SPEC_ONLY — PRE-REGISTRATION. No data acquired. No estimator fitted. No forecast emitted.
r1_statement: This document contains ZERO estimated quantities. Every number below is a threshold or a design constant chosen before seeing data, not a result.

objective.target: P(home team wins) for NFL regular-season games, as of a frozen pregame timestamp

as_of_discipline.rule: Every feature must be computable from information published strictly BEFORE the freeze timestamp. A feature that cannot be reconstructed as-of is DISQUALIFIED, not approximated.

freeze_schedule.T_minus_120: primary freeze — inactives are not yet official; features marked PROVISIONAL
freeze_schedule.T_minus_30: final verification — NFL inactives are official 90 minutes before kickoff, so this freeze uses CONFIRMED status
freeze_schedule.overwrite_rule: The T-120 provisional card is never overwritten. The T-30 card is a separate version. Both are retained and graded separately.

look_ahead_tests_required: for a random sample of games, re-derive every feature from sources timestamped before the freeze and assert byte-equality with the stored feature row
assert no feature draws on any row of the outcome table for the game being predicted or any later game

feature_blocks.intent: Offensive and defensive efficiency on 1st and 2nd down, which is less contaminated by score-state and clock effects than all-down EPA.
definition_constraints: restrict to 1st and 2nd down
exclude garbage time by a pregame-fixed win-probability band, not by score margin chosen after inspection
opponent-adjust (see opponent_adjustment block) — raw EPA rank is a schedule artifact
use a pre-registered shrinkage toward league mean for small samples; the shrinkage constant is fixed BEFORE fitting, not tuned on the validation window
feature_blocks.as_of_risk: LOW — play-by-play is published same-day and is not revised in a way that changes pregame availability.

feature_blocks.intent: Starting QB identity and health, the single largest personnel effect in the sport.
definition_constraints: starter identity as CONFIRMED at T-30 (inactives), PROVISIONAL at T-120
a QB change must be represented as a discrete level change, not as a smooth team-strength decay
backup quality is its own term; 'QB out' is not one number
feature_blocks.as_of_risk: MEDIUM — beat-reporter status is tier-3 until the official inactive list posts. PROVISIONAL/CONFIRMED must be recorded per the existing source-tier rules.

feature_blocks.intent: Offensive line continuity, which mediates the QB effect.
definition_constraints: count of projected Week-1 starters available, plus continuity (games this unit has started together)
position-weighted; LT and C are not interchangeable with RG
requires depth-chart state as-of kickoff
feature_blocks.as_of_risk: HIGH — depth charts are frequently revised retroactively. This block is the most likely to be DATA_BLOCKED and must be built so the model runs without it.

feature_blocks.intent: Strength-of-schedule correction applied to every efficiency input.
definition_constraints: adjust using only games played before the freeze
iterative/ridge-regularized adjustment, with the regularization fixed before fitting
early-season adjustment must shrink hard — a 2-game sample opponent adjustment is noise amplification

feature_blocks.intent: Days since last game and short-week/bye asymmetry.
definition_constraints: days-rest differential, plus explicit indicators for Thursday short week and post-bye
indicators, not a linear day count — the effect is not linear in days
feature_blocks.as_of_risk: NONE — schedule is known well in advance.

definition_constraints: great-circle distance, signed time-zone delta, and an international-game indicator
must not be conflated with home-field advantage, which is a separate constant

feature_blocks.intent: Wind, precipitation and temperature at kickoff, for outdoor venues only.
definition_constraints: FORECAST as-of the freeze, never the realized observation — using realized weather is look-ahead
dome/retractable-roof games take a fixed indoor level, not a forecast
wind is the term with real support; temperature effects are small and must not be over-parameterized
feature_blocks.as_of_risk: MEDIUM — requires storing the forecast at freeze time. It cannot be reconstructed later.

feature_blocks.intent: Skill-position and defensive-front availability beyond QB and OL.
definition_constraints: official injury report designations as-of the freeze, plus the official inactive list at T-30
aggregate by snap-share-weighted absence, not by player count
snap shares must come from games before the freeze

estimator.form: logistic regression on standardized features (link chosen a priori; the MLB work established that a linear-probability model ranks worse by AUC and produces out-of-range predictions)
estimator.regularization: ridge, penalty selected inside each training fold only
estimator.standardization: fitted on the training fold ONLY; never on the full sample
prohibited_without_a_new_pre-registratio: swapping to a tree ensemble or neural model
adding interaction terms discovered by inspecting validation performance
any feature added after seeing a validation result

validation.scheme: expanding-window walk-forward, strictly date-ordered. Random splits are prohibited — they leak future information across a season.
validation.minimum_train: one full prior season before the first forecast
metrics_required: Brier, with the Murphy decomposition (reliability / resolution / uncertainty)
calibration intercept and slope from logistic recalibration; the target is intercept 0, slope 1

inference.method: week-block bootstrap (resample whole WEEKS, not individual games — games in a week share weather regimes, schedule and injury-report timing)
inference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across all model comparisons reported in a release
inference.note: The MLB work found a comparison that looked significant at t = -1.98 and did not survive date-block bootstrap plus Holm (p_raw 0.062, p_holm 0.375). Assume the same will happen here.

validation.ablations_required: leave-one-block-out walk-forward for every feature block above. A block that does not improve out-of-sample Brier is removed, regardless of coefficient magnitude.
validation.coefficient_rule: Coefficient magnitude is NOT evidence. Only out-of-sample improvement under the bootstrap is evidence.

pre_registered_thresholds.note: Fixed before any data is acquired. Changing them requires a new record, not an edit to this one.
promotion_requires_all_of: out-of-sample Brier better than a home-field-only baseline, with the week-block bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero after Holm
calibration slope within [0.85, 1.15] and intercept within [-0.15, 0.15]
ROC-AUC above the baseline on the same folds
every retained block passing its own ablation
a full look-ahead audit passing on a random sample of frozen feature rows
pre_registered_thresholds.gate_on_failure: NO_PROMOTE. A failed threshold is a result, not a reason to retune.

execution_status.note: This spec authorizes building and measuring. It authorizes no wager and no promotion.

known_blockers_at_spec_time: No NFL play-by-play, injury, depth-chart, schedule or weather data exists in this repository. Every block above is currently DATA_BLOCKED.
ol_health and weather require prospective capture; weather forecasts in particular cannot be reconstructed after the fact.
Until acquisition completes, the correct status is DATA_BLOCKED, not a degraded model.
